title: GTA 6 Sales Numbers: Week 1 in 4 Numbers
caption:
GTA 6's launch week, scored: $3.79 billion and 32.5 million copies through the end of launch day (Rockstar/Take-Two). That's 5.2x Red Dead 2's $725M opening weekend (our math), plus 8 Game Awards nominations.
Which number surprised you most?

Sources: Rockstar Games / Take-Two (20 Nov) via GamingBolt and PC Gamer; Take-Two (RDR2, 2018); The Game Awards
ig_first_line: 5.2x Red Dead 2's opening weekend. GTA 6's first week, in 4 numbers.
